pose_comparison.special: raised index finger and wink, rather than extended open palm
pose_comparison.rank1: both hands on hips and laughing rather than raised fists or clasped hands
pose_comparison.rank2: adjusting tie, rather than peace sign or cheek touch
pose_comparison.rank3: classic folded arms across chest, rather than hand behind head or low sleeve pinching
pose_comparison.rank4: palm on front forehead and other open hand by waist, rather than hands in front or sleeve self-hug

limitations: Different male physique is preserved; head size and shoulder locations are not numerically identical across poses.
Hands inside pocket or behind crossed sleeve are naturally occluded; unseen fingers cannot be individually counted.
The front forehead touch differs from chara1 back-of-head touch by contact and context.
icon face portrait purpose is shared across characters; expression is intentionally more self-satisfied.
